title: ClientConfig Default split (30s/1/8/64 MiB) is a well-calibrated choice
description: 30s request timeout covers realistic API latency without hanging forever; excluded from SSE/WS by design (doc says so). 1 MiB session cap: Session JSON is small, 1 MiB is generous. 8 MiB call cap: multi-method batches can carry meaningful payloads; 8 MiB is the right order of magnitude. 64 MiB blob cap: allows realistic file sizes without enabling DoS. All fields are pub so callers can override per-deployment. A contributor might try to unify all caps into one field or add a 'default_for_mobile' constructor — the current split correctly distinguishes three different response types with different size profiles.
